actions.info: Interactive administrative operation runner: create products, issue keys, grant credits, and publish pricing versions.

products.info: Catalog of products and services. Each product groups related features, pricing plans, and routing rules for isolated billing and metering.

plans.info: Manage subscription plans and their version lifecycle. Create plans, publish version updates with limits and grants, or sunset deprecated versions.

pricing.info: Pricing matrix: define billed features, base execution costs in credits, per-unit multipliers, and one-off credit packages.

margins.info: Margin and markup rules. Configure percentage tiers and minimum charges applied on top of raw provider resource costs.

keys.info: Manage system and customer API keys. Issue scoped access tokens bound to products with instant revocation capability.

routes.info: AI provider routing configuration. Maps external models to specific upstream providers, fallback routes, and cost price tables.

tasks.info: Log of background billing and reconciliation tasks: recurring accruals, balance reconciliations, and payment gateway syncs.

hints.actionHeader: Form for creating and updating entities. Select an action type and fill in the required parameters.

fieldHints.actionSelect: Select the administrative action type to create an entity or modify billing parameters.
fieldHints.adminToken: Secret staff token for authentication against the billing admin API.
fieldHints.code: Unique alphanumeric slug in lowercase without spaces (e.g. ai-chat, pro-monthly).
fieldHints.name: Human-readable display name shown in the catalog and user receipts (e.g. Pro Monthly).
fieldHints.productId: Unique product identifier (UUID) that this entity or operation belongs to.
fieldHints.planId: Parent pricing plan identifier (UUID) for which this version is being created.
fieldHints.routeId: AI route identifier (UUID) specifying the target provider, model, and variant.
fieldHints.featureId: Feature or action identifier (UUID) for which the price is being defined.
fieldHints.accountId: Customer account or organization identifier (UUID) being targeted.
fieldHints.creditRateVersionId: Published credit rate version identifier (UUID) used for currency conversion.
fieldHints.version: Sequential version number (integer: 1, 2, 3...). Plan and pricing updates are published as new versions.
fieldHints.creditGrants: JSON array of recurring credit grants. Example: [{"bucket":"ai","amountMilli":5000000}].
fieldHints.limits: JSON object of rate limits or quotas. Example: {"rpm":60,"monthly":10000}.
fieldHints.entitlements: JSON array of granted feature flags. Example: ["gpt-4o","priority_support"].
fieldHints.creditGrantInterval: Base interval for recurring credit grants: day, week, month, or year.
fieldHints.creditGrantIntervalCount: Interval multiplier (usually 1 — every month or day).
fieldHints.creditsMilli: Price per unit in milli-credits (1 credit = 1000 milli-credits. 500 = 0.5 credits).
fieldHints.unit: Base consumption measurement unit (e.g. request, token, second, image).
fieldHints.per: Number of units per specified price (e.g. 1 for a single request, or 1000 for 1k tokens).
fieldHints.creditValueMicros: Value of 1 credit in US dollar micros ($1.00 = 1,000,000 micros).
fieldHints.tiers: JSON definition of tiered markup or discount brackets. Example: [{"upTo":10000,"markupPercent":20}].
fieldHints.minChargeMilli: Minimum charge threshold per single request in milli-credits.
fieldHints.provider: Model provider name (e.g. openai, anthropic, google, deepseek).
fieldHints.model: Provider model identifier (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, gemini-1.5-pro).
fieldHints.variant: Route variant configuration (e.g. default, streaming, reasoning).
fieldHints.kind: Entity type (for plans: subscription/usage; for routes: chat/completion/embedding).
fieldHints.productScope: Scope of the plan: comma-separated product codes or "all" for a global plan.
fieldHints.key: Unique feature metering key (e.g. ai.chat.completion, export.pdf).
fieldHints.pricing: Feature pricing model: fixed or metered.
fieldHints.scopes: API key permissions separated by spaces or commas (e.g. billing:read api:invoke *).
fieldHints.target: Target publication entity type: version, rate, routePrice, or markup.
fieldHints.id: Unique record identifier (UUID) to publish, revoke, or terminate.
fieldHints.items: JSON array of route price items (input/output tokens, tool invocations).
fieldHints.window: Time window for rate limiting: minute, hour, day, or month.
fieldHints.meter: Meter counter identifier: requests, credits, or cost_nanos.
fieldHints.max: Maximum allowed meter threshold within the window.
